subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: What should the default contract be for completed run-mode subagent sessions: auto-archive them after archiveAfterMinutes, retain but hide them from active/status surfaces, or keep current retention and update docs?
rationale: Current code and tests preserve keep-mode retention while docs promise auto-archive, and changing the default affects retained history, attachments, Control UI status, and users relying on completed child transcripts.

options.title: Retain but hide active status
options.body: Keep completed subagent history by default while changing sessions/status/Control UI projections so terminal child runs do not look active or block the parent workflow.

options.title: Auto-archive run-mode subagents
options.body: Make archiveAfterMinutes apply to completed run-mode subagents by default, preserving transcript archives while removing stale child rows from active list surfaces.

options.title: Keep retention and fix docs
options.body: Document that default cleanup keeps run-mode subagent sessions and require callers to opt into cleanup="delete" for archival behavior.

recommendation.title: Retain but hide active status
recommendation.body: Keep completed subagent history by default while changing sessions/status/Control UI projections so terminal child runs do not look active or block the parent workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across subagent lifecycle, session listing, and Control UI session surfaces.
